top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks to Katori and Ye is a mature, clean discovery: the magic-wavelength lattice cancels the light shift to first order and lets thousands of neutral atoms be interrogated coherently in the Lamb-Dicke regime. The 1e-18 agreement between independent laboratories and the millimetre-scale gravitational redshift are measured results, not promises. All eight members converge on the same two names, the citation is narrow enough to separate it from the 2005 comb and 2012 trapped-ion prizes, and no award would leave a ripe, well-attributed achievement unrewarded.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; I work in superconducting circuits, not atomic clocks, though as WACQT director I am a quantum-technology colleague of metrology-adjacent groups
